items.title: Lumentum (LITE) Q1 Earnings Spotlight AI Optics Strength And Loss Risk
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings slipped 0.6% in the latest session heading into this Q1 2027 print, a soft move for a stock that has been volatile over recent months. Traders reacted to headlines. Long-term holders are staring at something else entirely. The firm just posted quarterly revenue of US$1.26b and basic earnings per share of US$3.90, in the context of trailing twelve month losses of about US$6.6b. The tension between a P/S multiple of 16.5x and that loss profile is now the central consideration...

items.title: Gary Black Warns Tesla Bulls: In a SpaceX Merger, “Arbs Will Whittle Down” the Premium
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGary Black told Tesla bulls that in an all-stock SpaceX-Tesla deal, merger arbs would whittle down the 20-25% premium he expects. Marvell’s all-stock offer for Lumentum shows how it works: a 24% premium on paper became a 16% discount to Lumentum’s price before the leak, because Marvell’s shares fell 32%.
